input.overview: Viper Night Drivin' uses the left ramp for six events, the lower targets for Post-Save, and the two center lock holes for four-ball Multiball. Work the lock holes until Lock is lit, then lock one ball on each side; the second lock starts Multiball. Light Post-Save before beginning a dangerous feature, because the Launch button can then raise the center post.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the two center lock holes until Lock is lit, then lock one ball on each side; the second lock starts four-ball Multiball. Before starting, complete the lower targets to light Post-Save, which the Launch button activates.
input.summary: Build Lock at the two center holes, then lock one ball on each side to start four-ball Multiball. During it, shoot the center ramp for the first Jackpot, relock both balls for Double Jackpot, then use the two side ramps for Super Jackpots.

steps.text: Shoot the two center lock holes until the Lock lamps are ready, then put one ball into each lit side lock.
The second locked ball starts four-ball Multiball; shoot the center ramp for the first Jackpot.
After the center-ramp Jackpot, relock one ball in each side hole to collect the Double Jackpot.
Complete the left- and right-ramp Super Jackpots, returning to the center ramp when the sequence relights it.

alternatives.title: Notepad event route
alternatives.when: Use this when the left ramp is safer than the center lock holes.

steps.text: Build the displayed mileage while no other event is running.
When the left ramp flashes for Notepad, shoot it to start the selected event.
After an event, build another 20 miles to relight the Notepad route.
Complete the six Notepad events by qualifying each one with mileage and starting it at the flashing left ramp.
Keep Post-Save ready before an event or Multiball: complete the lower targets, then press Launch only when the save is needed.
After all Notepad events are complete, follow the flashing left-ramp and display direction into Mancow's Morning Madhouse.

machineSetup: Prefer CPU and display 2.01. ROM inventories also preserve 1.02, so verify the installed version before relying on event values or thresholds.
Check both center lock holes, all three ramps, lower Post-Save targets, Launch button, center post, inlanes, and both raccoon targets before competitive play.

cautions.issue: The center holes, ramp returns, and raccoon targets can reject the ball toward the middle.
cautions.response: Light Post-Save before committing to those shots, then use the Launch button to raise the center post when a rebound threatens the drain.
